name: rook
description: rook by TestMu AI inside Claude Code: Claude runs rook against the agent it is building, a live verdict pane, re-test prompts after agent edits, failures fed back as fix context, a status line score, /rook commands and a production-target guard.

rookPath.title: rook executable
rookPath.description: The rook CLI to run: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

pane.title: Verdict pane
pane.description: auto opens the live pane when a session starts in a rook workspace (on terminals wide enough to dock it); command opens it only on /rook; off never opens it.

statusLine.title: Status line score
statusLine.description: Show the latest run's Pass / Fail / Unable to Verify counts and the trend against the previous run.

retestBand.title: Re-test prompt
retestBand.description: When Claude edits a file the agent under test is built from, show which scenarios touch it and offer to re-run them.

failureContext.title: Failures as context
failureContext.description: When a run you started elsewhere finishes with failures, hand Claude the failing criteria, expected versus achieved, and the evidence quotes.

prodGuard.title: Production guard
prodGuard.description: Refuse rook runs whose target looks like production until you confirm with /rook confirm-prod. The agent's writes are real and rook cannot roll them back.

prodPatterns.title: Production markers
prodPatterns.description: Comma-separated words that mark a target as production when they appear as a whole word in its endpoint, domain, command or environment values.
